fields.objective: Amplify target DNA sequence using polymerase chain reaction
fields.materials:
- DNA template
- Forward primer
- Reverse primer
- Taq polymerase or high-fidelity polymerase
- dNTPs
- PCR buffer
- MgCl2 (if not in buffer)
- Nuclease-free water
- PCR tubes or plate
- Thermal cycler

protocol.description:
Prepare PCR master mix on ice:
  - PCR buffer (1x final)
  - dNTPs (200 μM each)
  - Forward primer (0.5 μM)
  - Reverse primer (0.5 μM)
  - Taq polymerase (1-2.5 units)
  - Water to final volume
Add template DNA (10-100 ng for genomic DNA, or 1-10 ng for plasmid)

Load into thermal cycler and run program:
  - Initial denaturation: 95°C for 3-5 min
  - 25-35 cycles:
    * Denaturation: 95°C for 30 sec
    * Annealing: 50-65°C for 30 sec
    * Extension: 72°C for 1 min/kb
  - Final extension: 72°C for 5-10 min
  - Hold at 4°C

Run gel electrophoresis to verify PCR product:
  - Prepare 1-2% agarose gel
  - Load 5-10 μL PCR product with loading dye
  - Include DNA ladder
  - Run at 100V for 30-45 min
Image gel under UV light and document results

fields.observations:
- Record gel image
- Note band intensity and specificity
- Document any unexpected bands or smearing
